channel.title: Dan Patrick Show (Filtered)
channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.
channel.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Multi-Sport Madness, U2 Controversy
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes talk about the aura surrounding Bo Jackson in his heyday and how Deion Sanders aspired to those same heights as a multi-sport athlete. Dan and Dylan clash hard over U2 and whether this is actually an all-time great band or whether they are just annoying.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Netflix Negligence, Albert Breer
item.description:
Netflix blows off the Dan Patrick Show and doesn’t make anyone from Thursday’s NFL broadcast available. But does the rest of the country know the game is on Netflix tonight? MMQB’s Albert Breer joins Dan to talk about the continued international expansion of the NFL, including potentially moving into the Middle East or even holding a Super Bowl outside the United States; plus, Albert dishes on the timeline for Aaron Donald and what all happened with Drake Maye last night.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Drake Maye Disappointment, Joe Thomas
item.description:
The NFL returned with a roar on Wednesday night with a Super Bowl rematch. The Seahawks claimed victory again, but Dan has his microscope on Patriots’ quarterback Drake Maye as he throws three interceptions in the 4th quarter. Pro Football Hall of Famer Joe Thomas talks about how the Seahawks adjusted when quarterback Sam Darnold left the game, and how the Rams and 49ers will be impacted by different travel schedules to Australia.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – 25 Years Later, Steve Young
item.description:
Dan reflects on the 25th anniversary of the September 11th tragedy. Hall of Fame quarterback and football analyst Steve Young joins Dan to talk about the travel logistics handled by the Rams and 49ers to play in Australia, who’s facing the biggest questions in this NFL season, what kind of fights he would get into; Steve and Dan spar over his golf game at Tahoe too.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Charles Davis, College Football Week 2
item.description:
College football analyst Charles Davis joins Dan to discuss storylines going into Week 2 of the college season, including how close Boise St. got to beating Oregon, the continued drama over Michigan and the pressure on Texas and Ohio State as they meet this weekend. The Danettes weigh in on the most interesting and least interesting NFL games, and the Most Must Win games of the college slate.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Travel Woes, Guardian Caps, Taxes
item.description:
While the world is blaming the Rams travel arrangements for their dismal showing last night from Australia, Dan thinks the answer is much simpler. Fritzy has to wear a guardian cap. Dan and callers discuss the weird situation around the idea that Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford has to pay million in taxes to play Week 1 – or does he?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Not So Fast Episode 9
item.description:
On today's show, Pabst & Perloff break down the 49ers dominant win over the Rams in Australia, preview the weekend in college football with NBC's Connor Rogers, preview some of the biggest games on Sunday in Week 1 of the NFL, give their latest Warm Takes and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Over Reaction Monday
item.description:
Tony Reali is in for Dan and the Danette's on The Dan Patrick Show. Tony and the guys with their Edition "Over Reaction Monday" to the biggest upsets in College Football & NFL as well as the biggest surprise wins. They also discuss the crazy finish to the Lions & Sains game and the controversial forward pass.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Kevin Clark joins the show!
item.description:
Tony Reali is in for Dan and the Danette's on The Dan Patrick Show. NFL writer Kevin Clark joins the show to talk NFL Week 1 & what are the biggest takeaways from all the suprising outcomes heading into Week 2.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Fumble or Incomplete Pass
item.description:
Tony Reali in for Dan and The Dannette's, Tony and the guys pose the question if wearing too much sports geat to a game a good or a bad thing? They then go back to the Saints & Lions game to further break down the controversial ruling of an incomplete pass when Jared Goff got sacked.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – NFL Week 1 Recap, Deion Sanders to FSU?
item.description:
Dan recaps the action from Week 1 of the NFL season and focuses on which quarterbacks need to show improvement or start looking for new work. And he speculates on the chances that Deion Sanders might eventually return to his alma mater, Florida State, as their head coach.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Hollywood Rules, Nick Wright
item.description:
Dan explains his absence yesterday when he was doing some pickups for his latest Adam Sandler project and says he doesn’t understand why everyone gets to heated about the Monday Night Football broadcast showing Taylor Swift repeatedly throughout the game. And friend of the show and huge Chiefs homer, Nick Wright drops by to crow about Patrick Mahomes strong performance last night.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Chiefs Still Team to Beat in AFC West, Bill Cowher
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes figure the Kansas City Chiefs are still the team to beat in the AFC West after they manhandled the Denver Broncos last night. And former Steelers HC and current NFL analyst Bill Cowher drops by to weigh in everything that happened in Week 1 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Protect College Sports Act, Tiger Comeback
item.description:
Dan explains the “Protect College Sports Act” and how it could reshape the landscape of college sports. Plus, DP and the Danettes consider Tiger Wood’s plan for a comeback and whether he can still compete for a major championship.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Clippers Story Feels Like It’s Not Over, Domonique Foxworth
item.description:
The NBA says the investigation into the Clippers circumventing the salary cap to pay Kawhi Leonard is over now that owner Steve Ballmer has accepted his punishment, but Dan feels like there’s still more to learn. And NFL analyst Domonique Foxworth drops by to break down Week 1 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – A New Low for the Mets, Week 1 Underreaction
item.description:
Mets fans gave Pete Alonso a hero’s welcome in his return to Citi Field with the Baltimore Orioles and Dan calls it a new low for the franchise. Plus, Dan isn’t really sure exactly what to think about the NFL after Week 1 of the season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Dan Patrick Takes A Gamble - Episode 221: A Humongous Burrito
item.description:
The guys try to keep it cleaner this episode after management asks them to cut down on the swearing. Dylan and Ray attempt to break the record for fastest-eaten burrito before everyone eventually gets around to making their weekly football picks.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Bears Are All O and No D, Andrew Whitworth
item.description:
The Chicago Bears offense may be gunning for the NFL scoring record, but can they keep points off the board for the other team? Former NFL OT and current football analyst, Andrew Whitworth joins Dan and weighs in on Lane Kiffin coaching his alma mater and how things shifted when he came to LSU; plus, he previews tonight’s Thursday Night Football game between the Bills and Lions.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Lane Kiffin’s “Gamesmanship,” Jayson Tatum
item.description:
His starting quarterback is doubtful for the big game against Ole Miss, but is LSU head coach Lane Kiffin looking for an excuse or is it just spin? Plus, Boston Celtics star Jayson Tatum joins Dan to discuss his return from his Achilles injury and the struggles he went through to get back to the basketball court; plus, who he is more concerned about in the Eastern Conference between the Knicks and 76ers.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 –New Stadium for TNF, FBS Oversight Committee Is Useless
item.description:
Thursday Night Football will debut the Bills’ new stadium and DP is looking forward to tonight’s matchup. And the FBS Oversight Committee determined Michigan should not have gotten that extra second that let them win over Western Michigan but doesn’t have the authority to change the outcome – so Dan wonders what the point of this committee is.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Lane Kiffin Shenanigans, Taylor Lewan
item.description:
Dan reacts to Thursday Night Football as Josh Allen and the Bills romp over a bad Lions defense and Josh Allen stakes out an early bid for MVP. The timing on LSU quarterback Sam Leavitt’s injury updates is off and odd, and Dan doesn’t buy what Lane Kiffin is trying to pull off. Former NFL tackle and “Bussin’ with the Boys” host Taylor Lewan joins Dan and brushes off the Western Michigan-Michigan controversy, talks about setting up a showdown between Michigan and Nebraska, and what snapshot he would take of his own NFL career.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Window Closing for Lions?, Pressure
item.description:
The Lions’ defense was banged up and woeful against the Bills on Thursday Night; while the core nucleus is still there in Detroit, Dan isn’t quite sure what the future holds for the team right now. Who is under more pressure in college football: Bill Belichick at North Carolina or Lincoln Riley at USC?

item.title: Hour 3 – Numerology, Rick Neuheisel
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes get into some of the numbers behind Week 2 in the NFL, including some betting lines. And former college football HC Rick Neuheisel drops by to weigh in on all the college football action from the weekend.

item.title: Hour 2 – Louis Riddick, Todd Who?
item.description:
Dan checks on the early season NFL MVP favorites and gets a breakdown of Week 2 from Louis Riddick. Plus, an unprecedented battle of Todd’s took place over the weekend and the Danettes consider what it would take to name their baby, “Todd.”

item.title: Hour 1 – Football, Football, Football!
item.description:
As usual on a Monday morning, DP and the Danettes recap a busy weekend with college football across the pond and some surprising results from Week 2 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – Overshadowed Tuesday, Albert Breer
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the NFL players who had good weeks on the gridiron and just aren’t getting the love they probably deserve. And NFL insider Albert Breer stops by to break down Week 2 of the NFL now that it’s been completed.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 2 – Jameis Winston Pick Machine, Michael Irvin
item.description:
Giants QB Jaxson Dart went down early in last night Monday Night Football game giving backup QB Jameis Winston the opportunity to add to impressive amount of career interceptions. Plus, Hall of Famer Michael Irvin stops by to chat with Dan about his alma mater Miami, Jeremiah Smith, and if he has any beef with people he played against. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1 – Rams Roll, Tyler Shough
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes recap last night’s statement victory by the Los Angeles Rams. And fresh off of the Saints' win over the Ravens on Sunday, New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough joins the show to talk about the progression in his career.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 - Executive Decisions in Colorado
item.description:
Dan & the Danette's talk about Bears third string QB Case Keenum possibly starting against the Eagles, Deion Sanders removing players from Colorado's roster following their blowout loss to Northwestern, thoughts on the Commanders and Giants following injuries to both team's starting QBs, and more!

item.title: Hour 2 - Caught Off Guard, Ross Tucker
item.description:
Dan has more thoughts on Mike McDonald's comments during his interview and if McDonald's comments were never meant to be heard by anyone, Ross Tucker joins the show to give his thoughts on some NFL Week 3 matchups and the Broncos - Seahawks accusations, and more!

item.title: Hour 1 - Mike McDonald v Sean Payton, Chase Daniel
item.description:
Dan Patrick and the Danette's discuss Seahawks head coach Mike McDonald revealing that Broncos head coach Sean Payton accused Seattle of cheating, preview Thursday Night Football between the Packers and the Falcons, former NFL QB and current analyst Chase Daniel joins the show to talk about some Week 3 matchups across the NFL, and more!
